name: jenkins
description: Jenkins MCP server for managing jobs, builds, and artifacts

tools.name: jenkins_list_instances
tools.description: List all configured Jenkins instances with their names and URLs

tools.name: jenkins_list_jobs
tools.description: List Jenkins jobs and folders with full paths; pass recursive to traverse nested folders

tools.name: jenkins_search_jobs
tools.description: Search for Jenkins jobs by name (case-insensitive substring match)

tools.name: jenkins_get_job_status
tools.description: Get the status of the last build for a specific job

tools.name: jenkins_get_job_parameters
tools.description: Get the parameter definitions for a parameterised Jenkins job — names, types, defaults, and choices

tools.name: jenkins_get_build_status
tools.description: Get detailed status of a specific build number for a job

tools.name: jenkins_get_recent_builds
tools.description: Get recent builds for a job with their status and metadata

tools.name: jenkins_get_console_log
tools.description: Get a bounded console log chunk. Use nextCursor to continue; fullLog is a deprecated alias of the bounded logChunk and may be partial.

tools.name: jenkins_trigger_build
tools.description: Trigger a new build for a job, optionally with parameters

tools.name: jenkins_list_artifacts
tools.description: List all artifacts produced by a specific build

tools.name: jenkins_get_artifact
tools.description: Download a specific artifact from a build (returns base64-encoded content)

tools.name: jenkins_stop_build
tools.description: Stop/abort a running build

tools.name: jenkins_delete_build
tools.description: Delete a specific build

tools.name: jenkins_get_test_results
tools.description: Get test results for a build (pass/fail counts, test suites)

tools.name: jenkins_get_build_changes
tools.description: Get Git commits/changes for a build

tools.name: jenkins_get_pipeline_stages
tools.description: Get pipeline stages and their status for a build

tools.name: jenkins_replay_build
tools.description: Replay/rerun a pipeline build, optionally with a modified pipeline script

tools.name: jenkins_get_queue
tools.description: Get the current build queue showing pending builds

tools.name: jenkins_cancel_queue
tools.description: Cancel a queued build by queue ID

tools.name: jenkins_enable_job
tools.description: Enable a disabled job

tools.name: jenkins_disable_job
tools.description: Disable a job to prevent it from running

tools.name: jenkins_delete_job
tools.description: Permanently delete a job (WARNING: cannot be undone)

tools.name: jenkins_get_job_config
tools.description: Get job configuration XML

tools.name: jenkins_list_nodes
tools.description: List all Jenkins nodes/agents and their status. Use each result's name with get_node or toggle_node_offline; displayName is for display only.

tools.name: jenkins_get_system_info
tools.description: Get Jenkins system information

tools.name: jenkins_get_version
tools.description: Get Jenkins version

tools.name: jenkins_get_plugins
tools.description: List all installed Jenkins plugins

tools.name: jenkins_create_job
tools.description: Create a new Jenkins job from an XML configuration

tools.name: jenkins_update_job_config
tools.description: Update an existing job's XML configuration

tools.name: jenkins_rename_job
tools.description: Rename a Jenkins job

tools.name: jenkins_copy_job
tools.description: Copy/duplicate a Jenkins job under a new name

tools.name: jenkins_get_node
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific Jenkins node/agent

tools.name: jenkins_toggle_node_offline
tools.description: Toggle a Jenkins node/agent between online and offline

tools.name: jenkins_list_views
tools.description: List all Jenkins views with their jobs

tools.name: jenkins_get_view
tools.description: Get details and job list for a specific Jenkins view

tools.name: jenkins_quiet_down
tools.description: Put Jenkins into quiet mode — no new builds will start until cancelled (requires confirm: true)

tools.name: jenkins_cancel_quiet_down
tools.description: Cancel Jenkins quiet mode and resume accepting new builds

tools.name: jenkins_safe_restart
tools.description: Safely restart Jenkins — waits for running builds to finish before restarting (requires confirm: true)
